summary: Posiflex Technology is a POS hardware and self-service technology manufacturer whose product line includes the GT Series POS terminal, Mozart BT Series (convertible POS/self-service kiosk), and Mercury/Cachet self-service kiosks, plus mobile computing and kitchen display hardware for retail and restaurant environments.

Posiflex showcased its retail and restaurant technology portfolio at RetailNOW 2026 (July 26-28, Caesars Forum, Las Vegas), highlighting hardware integrations with software/kiosk partners GRUBBRR and Restroworks to demonstrate complete end-to-end solutions.

Posiflex has grown historically through acquisition, including KIOSK Information Systems (a self-service kiosk manufacturer) and Portwell (a specialty embedded-computing supplier), expanding its hardware portfolio beyond its original POS terminal line.
